instruction: Place the red apple into the empty shallow fruit bowl on the kitchen counter.

objects.description: A naturally proportioned ripe red apple, about 6.5 cm across, with softly irregular rounded shape and a compact side body for parallel-finger grasp; the stem is not a handle.

An ordinary rigid ceramic countertop fruit bowl with a shallow rotational profile, stable thick flat base, continuous side wall, rounded rim, and a real concave cavity in visual and collision geometry. Empty initially and visibly contains the apple after stable release.

geometry_constraints.cavity: closed physical concave interior in both visual and collision geometry
required_checks: apple fully outside with visible gap initially
ordinary gripper entry and release clearance

objects.description: A verified single-link static countertop slab support, physical revision 1353, bounds-authored under the unchanged apple and bowl layout; original slab source and 0.08 m thickness retained.

initial_state: In a tidy lived-in home kitchen, one red apple rests fully outside an empty shallow fruit bowl on the counter with a visible reachable gap. The bowl is stable, empty, and its broad concave interior is clearly visible; the task is unsolved and the apple is not pre-positioned over or inside the bowl; keep both ordinary-sized, uncluttered and reachable with native camera visibility. Intended basic grasp-and-place difficulty: compact apple body with multiple plausible side or oblique grasps and no precise orientation requirement. Support is the explicit single-link static countertop slab revision 1353; the apple and bowl sources and their natural outside initial arrangement are unchanged.
